answer: Keeping 179 aliases alive as a result means 179 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the lotus quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the ridge log shows the live set and the basalt audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 818 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
